notes.note: Reviewed the hidden-draft sizing feedback fix against the composer interaction, short-dock reservation, status-row and retained draft claims in chat-composer and getting-started. Suppression is identity-based, only while the draft remains unmeasurable, and excludes real or mixed child mutations. Visible reconciliation, sibling resize observation, send controls and draft persistence are unchanged. Focused Chromium reveal-without-typing, pinned transcript, cap/shrink, status and keyboard cases passed; this is not physical-device or visible-speedup evidence. Existing explanations remain accurate; no prose change.
